title: Visitor Orientation — Blacksand City Network
author: Widow Administrative Office — Blacksand City
content:
WELCOME TO THEEV.

You have been cleared through the Skull. This means someone vouched for you, or you bought your way in, or both. Either way, you are here now.

The Law of the Lords applies in this starport, in the Upper City, and in any building or zone marked with red flags. Under the Law of the Lords: no murder, no weapons fire, no conduct that disturbs the calm and tranquility of the city.

Everywhere else — the canyons, the lower streets, any unflagged zone — the Law of the Street applies. The only restriction in street zones is a prohibition on any weapon capable of breaching environmental containment.

The punishment for violating either law is the same.

Death.

The red flag zones move. A building that is protected today may not be protected tomorrow. Plan accordingly.

The Widows are always watching. You will not see them until it is relevant.

Welcome to Blacksand City.

title: Shipyard Notice — Kallos Shipyards
author: Kallos Shipyards — Front Office
content:
KALLOS SHIPYARDS
ACQUISITION · REFIT · RECYCLING

We buy hulls. We sell hulls. Our yard is open to anyone the Skull clears.

Client expectations:
— Bring the ship or don't. Don't bring a dispute about the ship.
— Any item secured aboard a hull at sale is the client's to remove. Anything left after the forty-eighth hour is ours.
— Outstanding Imperial warrants are not our business until they walk through our gate.

Current floor (rotating):
— Two stripped scout hulls, frame-only. Buyer fits the rest.
— An armed merchant, prior registry scrubbed, fresh paint, sold as-is.
— Bay 7-C: Far Trader, clean registry on file, currently held under a private owner's arrangement. Not listed for open sale. Inquiries handled through the owner's representative only.

Kallos does not guarantee discretion. Kallos guarantees that we have been doing this longer than the firms that used to guarantee it, and those firms are no longer on Theev.

title: Transit Exception Queue — Manual Clearance Notes
location: Blacksand Downport Public Grid, Customs Spillover
author: Acting Clerk // Rotation B
content:
Manual exceptions filed after midnight are usually paperwork problems, unpaid fuel notes, or people lying about crew count.

Pattern worth noting: two separate crews in the last six cycles requested departure windows within twelve minutes of each other, both listing "medical perishables" and both declining bonded escort. That's normally a smuggler tell, except one of the crews paid full legal tariff.

[[redacted diff=8 skill="Admin" attempts=3]]
Exception stamp accepted if form cites ROUTE CODE: CINDER-GLASS and includes crate tag "AGRICULTURAL YEASTERS". Dock bots won't open those without a live magistrate key, which nobody has at 03:00.[[/redacted]]

If your people are trying to leave quiet without looking like they're leaving quiet, this queue is where they fail first.
